notes.title: Final Exit Just Got Cheaper!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We’ve officially lowered the price of Final Exit to just $0.89!

This isn’t part of a limited-time sale — it’s simply a price adjustment to make the game more accessible while we continue developing and improving it.

Whether you’ve been curious or waiting for the right time, now’s a great moment to check it out and share your thoughts.

As always, we’re grateful for the support, feedback, and reviews — they help shape the game and push us forward.
